# http://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/723/B

n = int(input())
line = input()

line_without_parentheses = []

number_of_words_in_parentheses = 0
i = 0
while i < len(line):
    if line[i] == '(':
        line_without_parentheses.append('_')
        i += 1
        parentheses_words = []
        while line[i] != ')':
            parentheses_words.append(line[i])
            i += 1
        words_in_parentheses = ''.join(parentheses_words).split('_')
        for word in words_in_parentheses:
            if word:
                number_of_words_in_parentheses += 1
    else:
        line_without_parentheses.append(line[i])
    i += 1

max_word_length = 0
words_without_parentheses = ''.join(line_without_parentheses).split('_')
for word in words_without_parentheses:
    if word and len(word) > max_word_length:
        max_word_length = len(word)

print(f"{max_word_length} {number_of_words_in_parentheses}")
